title: Left-Quillen transport of special cosimplicial frames
statement: Use the model-category axioms and Reedy structures of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. Let $T:\mathcal M\rightleftarrows\mathcal N:U$ be an adjunction whose left functor preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations. Let $X$ be cofibrant. Let $S:\Delta\to\mathcal M$ be Reedy cofibrant with $S^0=X$ and augmentation $p:S\to\operatorname{const}X$ that is objectwise a weak equivalence with $p^0=1_X$. Let $S':\Delta\to\mathcal N$ be Reedy cofibrant with $S'^0=TX$ and augmentation $p':S'\to\operatorname{const}(TX)$ that is a Reedy trivial fibration with $p'^0=1_{TX}$. Then $TS$ is Reedy cofibrant and there exists a natural transformation $a:TS\to S'$ with $p'a=T(p)$ and $a^0=1_{TX}$, all of whose components are weak equivalences. Moreover $T$ sends every weak equivalence between cofibrant objects to a weak equivalence; in particular all structure and augmentation maps of $TS$ are weak equivalences.

source.place: Hovey, Model Categories, Theorem 5.2.8 (printed p.128), Proposition 5.4.7 (p.132), Lemma 5.5.1 (p.133); agent extraction of the Reedy lifting and comparison argument in the parent former step 12.
